verdict.rationale: Auth0 explicitly markets giving each agent a unique digital identity for accessing APIs, apps, and MCP servers. Its M2M client-credentials flow authenticates the application itself rather than a user, using its own Client ID and Secret. Access can be limited with scopes and granular permissions for M2M communications, and delegated OAuth keeps agents from getting broad, unrestricted access. Missing for 10: any evidence of instant revocation of an agent's credentials or tokens, depth on per-agent least-privilege scoping beyond marketing-level statements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
